parameters.name: CheckId
parameters.description: The ID of the check item.

parameters.name: CustomCheckConfig
parameters.description: The input parameters for custom check item validation.

parameters.name: CustomConfigs
parameters.description: The list of custom parameter configuration items for the check item.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the custom configuration item for the check item. The name is unique within the check item.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description: The operation type of the custom configuration item for the check item. Set this parameter to DELETE only for deletion operations. You do not need to specify this parameter for creation or update operations.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The user-configured value string of the custom configuration item for the check item.

parameters.name: RepairConfigs
parameters.description: The repair parameters supported by the repair feature of the check item.

sub_parameters.name: FlowId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the repair flow that corresponds to the repair operation.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the repair parameter for the check item. The name is unique within the check item.

sub_parameters.name: Operation
sub_parameters.description: The operation type of the custom configuration item for the check item. Set this parameter to DELETE only for deletion operations. You do not need to specify this parameter for creation or update operations.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The user-configured value string of the repair configuration item for the check item.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The validation type for Threat Detection Service parameters. Valid values:
- **REPAIR_CONFIG**: repair and custom parameter validation (default).
- **CHECK_ITEM_CONFIG**: custom check item validation.
